ValidationRule.description: Restrict editing of termination form fields
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( NSP_Verbal_Term_recd__c=FALSE, NSP_Written_Term_recd__c =FALSE, NOT($Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.AssetTrigger__c), OR( ISCHANGED( NSP_Verbal_Term_Date__c ) && NOT(ISBLANK(NSP_Verbal_Term_Date__c )), ISCHANGED( NSP_Anticipated_Date_Of_Termination__c) && NOT(ISBLANK(NSP_Anticipated_Date_Of_Termination__c)), ISCHANGED( NSP_Reason_for_Term__c ) && NOT(ISBLANK(NSP_Reason_for_Term__c )) )) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot edit these fields if verbal termination or written termination is not checked
